metadata.audio_delivery: Narration reaches the render as the single pre-mixed asset assets/audio/narration_master.wav (referenced in props.audio.narration.src). The per-segment list above is the editorial record of where each line sits; it is not a second mixing pass.
metadata.cut_note: One cut. The 25-step terminal choreography lives in the props file rather than in cuts[], because edit_decisions.cuts models source segments and there is no source footage — the scene is synthesized.

speed_plan.reason: No captured footage, so nothing to trim or ramp. Pace is authored via per-command typeSpeed.

metadata.audio_notes: Single speech track, mono 48kHz, no music, no ducking needed. Verified on the review stills that the caption band clears the terminal window's bottom edge.
metadata.theme_note: themeConfig is pinned to Remotion's DEFAULT_THEME (flat-motion-graphics: #0F172A ground, #22D3EE caption highlight) — the theme that produced the approved review stills. video_compose would otherwise inject the clean-professional playbook theme (white ground, dark captions) at render time and silently change the approved look. See decision d-010.
metadata.variant_notes: 16:9 only. 9:16 was ruled out at scene planning — the 110-char verification command cannot survive a vertical crop above legible type size.
